titulo.alumno: Novice · Places and basic directions: Essential vocabulary

intro: T1 · Beginner · Recognise letters, vocabulary and common phrases; understand basic grammar structures and short sentences from everyday life. Topic: Places and basic directions. Focus: Vocabulary.

texto: Essential vocabulary for spatial orientation and places in Thai: to ask where something is, use «อยู่ที่ไหน» (yùu thîi-nǎi, where is it?) or «...ไปทางไหน» (which way to...?). The noun travellers ask about most is «ห้องน้ำ» (hɔ̂ɔng-náam, toilet / bathroom, lit. water room). To give directions: «ตรงไป» (trong bpai, go straight ahead), «เลี้ยวซ้าย» (líao sáai, turn left) and «เลี้ยวขวา» (líao khwǎa, turn right). The word «ตลาด» (dtà-làat) refers to the traditional market.
